series.label: Copper [28], Ra < 0.1 μm
series.notes: Blue filled-triangle markers, series 'Copper [28]' under the 'Ra < 0.1 μm' legend bracket. Isolated by RGB color mask on a 600dpi raster render; axes calibrated from pixel positions of the four decade tick marks on each log axis (x: 0.01,0.1,1,10; y: 1,10,100,1000,10000). One blob (~1.8x baseline marker area) was split into two points via k-means on its pixel mask because two markers overlapped closely; the rest were isolated single-marker blobs.

series.label: Steel [29], Ra < 0.1 μm
series.notes: Magenta/pink filled-triangle markers, series 'Steel [29]' under the 'Ra < 0.1 μm' legend bracket. Isolated by RGB color mask; all 11 markers formed cleanly separated blobs of near-identical pixel area, so no splitting/merging was needed -- highest confidence of the four series.

series.label: Copper [28], Ra = 1.8 μm
series.notes: Red filled-circle markers, series 'Copper [28]' under the 'Ra = 1.8 μm' legend bracket. This cluster's 5 circles overlap heavily in a tight vertical run; connected-component blobs merged (one blob of ~4 markers plus one isolated marker), so the 4-marker blob was split into individual points via k-means on its pixel mask assuming a per-marker area equal to the isolated marker's area. Point positions/count are less certain than the two triangle series.

series.label: Steel [28], Ra = 1.8 μm
series.notes: Green filled-circle markers, series 'Steel [28]' under the 'Ra = 1.8 μm' legend bracket (legend prints '[28]' for this steel series, not '[29]' -- reproduced as printed). Several markers overlap into larger blobs (up to ~4.7x single-marker area); those blobs were split into individual points via k-means on pixel masks using the smallest isolated blob as the per-marker area estimate. Point count/positions in the densest region (dT~0.18-0.20) are the least certain in this figure.
